incidents.name: MINER ERC-X self-transfer balance duplication
incidents.notes: The MINER ERC-X token's _update() only rejected the zero address and never rejected from == to, so a transfer to the caller's own address credited the receiver before debiting the sender and doubled the balance, which the attacker looped 2000 times inside a Uniswap V3 swap callback before selling.

sources.ref: onchain review: the DeFiHackLabs PoC header names 0x732276168b421d4792e743711e1a48172ea574a2 as the victim but that address is the MINER/WETH UniswapV3Pool; the contract holding the flaw is the MINER ERC-X token 0xe77ec1bf3a5c95bfe3be7bdbacfe3ac1c7e454cd, created 2024-02-11 by 0x2bb152c4a84f91bb5eb740a36ce6bae45c97a1d7, not by attack sender 0xea75aec151f968b8de3789ca201a2a3a7faeefba; no upgrade events
